messages:
Kara (PM): Usability test: people keep clicking Copy then hitting Revoke. We need safer affordances and clearer language.
Owen (Design): My proposals: 1) Move Revoke into overflow; 2) Rename to 'Disable key' and show undo toast. Overflow keeps primary Copy visible.
Vik (Frontend): Overflow fine on desktop, mobile needs action sheet. Icon-only revoke hurts discovery; maybe show overflow icon that opens actions.
Priya (A11y): Ensure overflow and action sheet are keyboard accessible. All actions need aria-labels and focus management.
Sam (Backend): We currently soft-delete for 10m. UX wants an undo banner for 2m; backend can support a 2m UI undo while keeping 10m server-side. Need compliance sign-off for retention.
Kara (PM): Copy mismatch risk: legal uses 'revoke'. Suggest UI uses 'Disable (revokes in audit)'. Be explicit in hover/help text.
Owen (Design): Empty state: if user lacks perms, show 'Create key (admin only)' with inline link to request access. Tooltip is not enough for screen readers.
Priya (A11y): Inline explanatory text must be in DOM. Tooltips must be keyboard-triggerable. Undo toast must be focusable and announced as "action available: undo".
Vik (Frontend): Row density note: adding overflow and badges (role/last-used) means taller rows. We'll adjust CSS and responsive breakpoints. Also add small helper text: 'Last used: inference or management API'.
Sam (Backend): Bulk revoke: require confirm modal listing N keys and a typed confirmation for >10 keys. Rate-limit applies.
Kara (PM): Action items: Owen upload mocks for desktop/mobile; Priya to write a11y checklist; Vik/Sam to estimate dev. ComplianceBot: create ticket if retention UI surfaces audit durations.
ComplianceBot: Auto-note: open compliance ticket C-430 when UI mentions audit/revoke retention.
Kara (PM): Thanks team. Post mocks here and I'll consolidate copy options. :thumbsup:
